capabilities: Render margin notes using %%> %% syntax in Live Preview and Reading View
Color-code cues with semantic prefixes like ?, !, X-, V-
Blur marginalia for active recall study sessions
Convert margin notes into Anki-style flashcards
Transform marginalia into a temporary HTML layout for PDF export
extras: Callout- and block-based grouping marginalia render only in Reading View, not Live Preview. PDF export works by temporarily converting notes to HTML and must be restored afterward. Installation is recommended via the BRAT plugin.
problem: Obsidian has no native way to place notes in page margins, and its PDF export struggles with floating margin content.

relations.evidence: drop it into an Obsidian Canvas or an Excalidraw drawing
Turn your margin notes into Anki/Spaced Repetition cards instantly
Install the BRAT plugin from the Obsidian Community Plugins (search for "BRAT")

summary: Renders Cornell-style margin notes from %%> %% syntax, with semantic colors, blur-based active recall, flashcards, and a marginalia explorer sidebar.
